the tourism industry is a major economic force in many countries.
the tourism sector is an important economic activity and it has a great impact on the economy of a country.
the tourism planning process must be based on the principles and goals of sustainable development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach to the analysis of the relationship between sustainable tourism and the environment.
we have developed a model for sustainable tourism planning, based on the three pillars of sustainable development.

sustainable tourism planning is the process of managing tourism in such a way that it maintains the quality of the environment and culture, contributes to the economic benefits of the community and improves the well-being of the local population.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current state of the art of the sustainable tourism planning is not sufficient.
the current state of tourism in the country has a significant impact on the future state of tourism.
sustainable tourism is a complex and multi-faceted phenomenon.
